Nina Patel: Nina Patel: Let's anchor the discussion on scope and expected outcome. What has actually changed since the last check-in?

We have the last sprint closed 18 of 22 points and left two review items, and the signal I am watching is the agreed sprint capacity is 34 points after planned support coverage.
Olivia Chen: Olivia Chen: My concern is the identity-provider test environment has been unstable. If the identity team must provide a stable test tenant, what do we tell the people relying on this work?
